name: GoBank
description: A model bank built in Go that simulates retail banking operations at scale. Part game — how profitable can you run a bank? — and part engineering testbed for go-luca.
what: GoBank simulates a UK retail bank: savings, lending, payments, treasury, and full double-entry accounting. It runs in the browser via WASM or as a local HTTP server. You set interest rates, raise capital, and compete for customers against a market modelled on the BoE base rate.

current_aims.title: Customer behaviour model
current_aims.desc: Customers search, compare, switch, and stick based on rate competitiveness, bank reputation, and capitalisation health. Random acquisition spikes when rates are very attractive. Competitive landscape: other banks offer BoE base rate minus a spread; customers compare and switch on relative attractiveness.

current_aims.title: Capital management
current_aims.desc: Capital raise function. Minimum £5M to operate as a bank. UK 4.5% tier 1 capital ratio constrains lending beyond organic retained profits.

current_aims.title: Interest rates
current_aims.desc: Pre-calculated at rate-change time points. Negative rate support (Japan-style). Parameter hierarchies for rate setting (go-luca).

current_aims.title: SCV (Single Customer View)
current_aims.desc: FSCS regulatory report: all depositor details and aggregate balances within 24 hours of failure. Proving this at scale (100K+ customers) using CTE-based SQL. To be extracted from go-luca into a standalone sub-project incorporated into GoBank.

current_aims.title: Logging & reconciliation
current_aims.desc: Payment cycles, internal and external user actions with audit trail.

current_aims.title: RBAC
current_aims.desc: Admin role currently; infrastructure in place for future roles.

current_aims.title: Accounting
current_aims.desc: go-luca integration with accounting hierarchies and parameter hierarchies.

future_scope.title: Blue-green deployment
future_scope.desc: DB migrations then code migrations, compile-time verified, reversible at scale. Same pre-calculation approach as interest rates — migration is a time point.

future_scope.title: Log archival
future_scope.desc: Removing old data from active state.

future_scope.title: Accounting data archival
future_scope.desc: go-luca: only current pool in DB for scale; timelines live ~7 years then archived.

non_goals.title: Kubernetes / CloudSQL
non_goals.desc: No planned deployment to Kubernetes with CloudSQL.

non_goals.title: External identity providers
non_goals.desc: No planned connection of RBAC to GCP IAM or similar.

non_goals.title: Restoring archived data
non_goals.desc: Data archived beyond 7 years is not planned to be restorable.
